answer: Bind each identity to one company on a public business registry, storing only its hash: a fable of a thousand shell firms collapses when every registration must mirror a real filing, with directors, filings and taxes behind it. A sybil farmer would need a separate registered company for every fake, paying filing fees and legal exposure each time, while honest owners need just one. Like an ocean, the registry is broad but each vessel is named. Limit: it excludes people without a company, so it must be one option among several, not the only gate.
